items.title: Plastic Waste Management (Amendment) Rules, 2026
items.summary: Recycled-content provisions were revised, including statutory exemptions, treatment of multilayer plastic and specific importer fulfilment rules.
items.action: Review the applicable packaging basis, exemption evidence and official certificate mechanism before relying on planning estimates.

items.title: Migration to Common EPR Portal
items.summary: The old plastic packaging portal was discontinued and data transferred to the Common EPR Portal.
items.action: Compare migrated records against your previous records and report any discrepancies through the Common EPR Portal.
